title: Disability evacuation buddy card
summary: Records access needs before phones, lifts, roads, or transport fail.
content: Disability evacuation buddy card is a practical offline routine for accessibility evacuation. Ask the person what help they want; do not assume needs from appearance. Write mobility, communication, hearing, vision, sensory, medicine, device, battery, and privacy needs. Choose two buddies and one route that does not depend only on elevators. Pack chargers, batteries, documents, repair notes, and device instructions with the person. Practice a calm evacuation when safe and update the card after any change.
